name: SBC Restaurant & Beer Bar
notes: Food menu read from the restaurant's own Popmenu site (Milford location data: 33 New Haven Ave, 203-874-2337, Mon-Sat 11:30-10, Sun 11:30-9). Our old page had a wrong address (33 Edison Road). The rotating drink/beer list is not included. Asterisked items (cooked to order) had the asterisk removed.
taglineEn: Farm-fresh American food & local craft beer on the Milford harbor since 1997
